newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kyocera's parent current profit seen up.
newsitem.headline: Kyocera's parent current profit seen up.

text.p: Japanese electrical machinery maker Kyocera Corp is expected to post a parent current profit of about 50 billion yen in the six months to September 31, 1996, up about four percent from a year ago, due to robust demand for cellular phones, a newspaper said on Tuesday.
The upward trend is seen continuing throughout the current business year, the Japanese economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said.
It also expected Kyocera to post a parent current profit of 102.5 billion yen in 1996/97, which would be the largest parent current profit on record.
A spokesmen for Kyocera was not immediately available for comment.
